title: Indian Shores Camping and Cottage Resort

services.name: Camper Rentals
services.desc: Want to spend a day on beautiful Lake Tomahawk? We have fishing boats, pontoons, wave runners, canoes and more! Already have a boat? We offer over night slip rentals by the night or by the week. We even offer gasoline for your convenience. Cancellations made prior to 72 hours before a scheduled rental day will receive a full refund less $100.00 cancellation fee. Any cancellations made with less than 72 hours’ notice will result in a forfeiture of all monies paid. No refunds

gap: Prices, hours and eligibility are not copied here yet. We will ask when you request.
blurb: Enjoy camping, boating, fishing, mini golf, scenic trails and more! Don’t have a boat or wish you had a wave runner? No problem - rent one from our marina! Join us for a savory Old Fashioned or robust Bloody Mary at our on-site bar, the Shoreline Inn, which overlooks picturesque Lake Tomahawk.
